  {"step":4,"file":"xmlIO.c","function":"xmlEscapeText","line":309,"var":"tempBuf","code":"char tempBuf[12];","note":"For non-ASCII input, the helper formats a temporary hex character reference in a stack buffer."},
  {"step":5,"file":"xmlIO.c","function":"xmlEscapeText","line":329,"var":"repl","code":"repl = tempBuf;","note":"The replacement pointer is made to reference the stack buffer instead of heap memory."},
  {"step":6,"file":"xmlIO.c","function":"xmlEscapeText","line":360,"var":"repl","code":"memcpy(out, repl, replSize);","note":"The function copies from the temporary buffer while it is still in scope, then returns the accumulated escaped string."},

]
EOF
